scope: All8234 immutable usable source records and every provider-reported split/ADS event, including invalid or unavailable boundaries. No trading P&L, models or account output read. No network, correction or production edit.

audit_rules.nominal_convention: Replicate existing reported-future-split multiplier for OHLC and inverse for volume, independent of whether provider actually follows that convention; reconstructed values are not certified raw prices.
audit_rules.boundary: Latest source bar strictly before effective session; exact effective-session bar when present; first source bar on/after separately retained if event-session bar absent. No price forward-fill.
audit_rules.liquidity_proxy: Median of provider close*provider volume over20 pre-event bars; at least10 finite positive observations. Native currency. Proxy relies on consistent provider price/volume conventions and is not verified liquidity.
audit_rules.ratio_alignment_triage: large move plus abs(log((adj_effective/adj_prev)*(new_shares/old_shares))) <= log(1.2). Triage only; no diagnosis, exclusion, repair or economic threshold.

followup_sample.design: One minimum SHA256 rank per populated metadata stratum; return values and triage flags excluded from sample selection. No replacement based on future source success or profitability.
followup_sample.eligibility: Valid positive nonneutral provider factor, event effective by frozen cutoff, currencyUSD/CAD; missing price boundaries remain eligible and visible.
followup_sample.purpose: Independent issuer/exchange/depositary and raw/split price validation candidates, not statistical proof or correction authority. No automatic download in this task.

preservation: Raw bytes and existing artifacts unchanged. All failures, event directions, missing boundaries and source identities retained.
